name: Alma
source:
The leader and brains who manages the group of delinquents.

This red-haired young man is the leader of the Bad Apples. Taciturn and poker-faced, it is hard to to know what he's thinking. Because of that, most people in their first meeting tend to think of him as a scary person. But he is a person with a strong purpose and charisma, which makes all the members trust deeply in him.

[From [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2015/05/10/bad-apple-wars/]Otome Jikan[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Fudoh Alma.[/spoiler]
